args.title: Add persistence for export format selection
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Implement a mechanism to store the user's last selected export format, allowing the format choice to persist between sessions. This will likely involve storing the information in localStorage.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component in src/components/ExportButton.tsx initializes with a default format of 'csv'. There's no mechanism to remember or persist the export format between sessions as requested in the issue. Implementing this feature requires storing the user's last selected format, potentially using localStorage.
